chunks: Ismaʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said: Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:

The fuqahāʾ and the wise, when some of them wrote to others, would write with three things with no fourth alongside them: whoever makes the Hereafter his concern, Allah will suffice him regarding his concern from the world; whoever rectifies his inward self, Allah will rectify his outward state; and whoever rectifies what is between himself and Allah, Allah will rectify what is between himself and the people.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةُ: the Hereafter, the ultimate abode and final concern of the believer
key_terms.الْحُكَمَاءُ: the wise people distinguished by sound judgment
key_terms.الْفُقَهَاءُ: the jurists or scholars of religious understanding
key_terms.سَرِيرَتَهُ: his inward state, inner self, or hidden moral reality
key_terms.عَلَانِيَتَهُ: his outward state, what appears openly before others
key_terms.فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ: one’s relationship and standing with Allah
key_terms.فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ: one’s dealings and relations with other people

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام teach about fixing one’s relationship with Allah and the people?
ai.summary: This hadith presents three concise principles of ethical and spiritual reform transmitted from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It links concern for the Hereafter, inner sincerity, and a sound relationship with Allah to divine assistance in worldly affairs, outward conduct, and human relationships.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5845 - Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said that the Commander of the Faithful, said: "

The scholars and the wise, when writing to one another, would write with three pieces of advice, with no fourth: Whoever makes the Hereafter his concern, Allah (swt) will suffice him in his worldly concerns. Whoever rectifies his inner self, Allah (swt) will rectify his outward state. Whoever improves what is between him and Allah (swt), Allah (swt) will improve what is between him and people."
